frameworks.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A
limitations: One campaign, its tested scope only; a control is never declared satisfied.
A finding is linked to a control by its weakness class, CWE, ATT&CK technique or the ISO control the agent cited: a mislabelled category lands under another control.
« No weakness observed » requires server-recorded coverage of the control's weakness classes by a dispatched agent; it does not prove that every test of that class was run.
Applicability uses only facts declared or verified by the organisation; detection never decides it.
Clauses 4-10 and the organisational, people and physical controls are not assessed.
Agents' ISO citations are indicative; 2013 identifiers are mapped to 2022 identifiers by number.
frameworks.scope_note: Annex A controls a technical test can produce evidence for, plus the technological controls it cannot assess. Clauses 4 to 10 (the management system) are not assessed.

source.reuse: Control identifiers only: the titles and text of ISO/IEC 27001 are not reproduced; the description is Darkmoon's own summary of what a technical test can observe.

frameworks.label: GDPR (EU) 2016/679, art. 32 and 25
limitations: One campaign, its tested scope only; a control is never declared satisfied.
A finding is linked to a control by its weakness class, CWE, ATT&CK technique or the ISO control the agent cited: a mislabelled category lands under another control.
« No weakness observed » requires server-recorded coverage of the control's weakness classes by a dispatched agent; it does not prove that every test of that class was run.
Applicability uses only facts declared or verified by the organisation; detection never decides it.
Only the technical side of art. 32 is covered; art. 33-34 and the other obligations are not.
Personal data categories are never inferred from findings.
frameworks.scope_note: Only the technical side of the security of processing (art. 32) is covered. Breach notification (art. 33-34), records, impact assessments and the other obligations are organisational and not covered. An authorised test is not a personal data breach.
